name: Analyze Flow Cytometry Immunophenotyping
description: Analyze flow cytometry data to identify and quantify specific cell populations based on surface markers.
detailed_description: Analyze flow cytometry data to identify and quantify specific cell populations based on surface markers.
when_to_use: When you need analyze flow cytometry immunophenotyping analysis

parameters.fcs_file_path: [Required] Path to the FCS file containing flow cytometry data (str)
parameters.gating_strategy: [Required] Dictionary defining the gating strategy. Each key is a population name, and each value is a list of tuples (marker, operator, threshold) (dict)
parameters.compensation_matrix: [Optional] Spillover/compensation matrix to correct for fluorescence overlap
